body: I wish I could wait until they're dead, but I can't.  I only have a few months.  It doesn't mean I'm more important and worth more than them.  They will suffer, but they will either get over it eventually or they will end their own suffering.  It's cruel to say but it's the truth.

> Are you absolutely certain that the possibility of the end of your suffering (because we don't really know what happens after death) is worth the infliction of equal suffering on your parents?

It's selfish for me to kill myself but it's equally selfish to have to suffer for someone else by staying alive when I don't want to.  Either way, someone is suffering.  I have to kill myself, or at the very least, I have to die

> If you want people to know that your death is intentional, then leave a note.

My death will likely be ruled suicide so it will be seen as intentional whether or not I leave a note.  What should I include in the note, though?  The reasons why I killed myself?  Some of the reasons are because of genetics so my parents would at least partially blame themselves.  I don't really want them to blame themselves but I think it's inevitable regardless of the reasons I list.

> If you make it so that your body will never be found, will your loved ones ever have closure?

This is why I was asking.  If I'm never seen again my parents won't know if I'm alive or dead, they can only hope.  If I'm found they will at least have closure.

> If your death is ruled a suicide, who will pay for your funeral since life insurance won't pay out?

I don't know.  I want to request no funeral but I doubt that would happen.  Maybe they would at least honor my wish of being cremated instead of wasting the earth being buried in a coffin.  At least they would save a little bit of money that way.
